SELECT o.status, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS distinct_ids,
       MIN(o.order_ts_utc) AS min_ts, MAX(o.order_ts_utc) AS max_ts
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
GROUP BY 1

SELECT o.web_order_id, o.status, o.order_ts_utc, COUNT(f.sales_line_id) AS lines,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.category = 'ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test_lines,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_web_order x WHERE x.web_order_id = o.web_order_id) AS dup
FROM fact_web_order o
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.receipt_id = o.web_order_id
LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
GROUP BY ALL
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN p.category = 'ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
    OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_web_order x WHERE x.web_order_id = o.web_order_id) > 1

WITH day_orders AS (
  SELECT o.* FROM fact_web_order o
  WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
    AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders,
       COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS distinct_orders,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE web_order_id IN (
           SELECT f.receipt_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE p.category = 'ZZ Test')) AS test_orders,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE web_order_id NOT IN (SELECT receipt_id FROM fact_sales_line)) AS no_lines,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'processing') AS processing
FROM day_orders
